convert_ast_to_datapoints: run generate_new_trees.py to convert AST nodes from an input JSON file into new tree datapoints
convert_ast_nodes_with_value_splitting: run the convert function to split AST nodes with values into separate type and value nodes with adjusted child indices
generate_datapoints_from_ast_file: run generate_new_trees.py with --input_fp to parse a JSON lines file of ASTs and write converted datapoints to an output file
generate_datapoints_with_custom_output: run generate_new_trees.py with --input_fp and --out_fp to convert ASTs and write results to a custom output path
review_convert_function: review the convert function that transforms AST node lists by splitting value nodes and remapping child indices
